# ComplyEasy AI — Full Site Map for LLMs

ComplyEasy AI is an AI-powered compliance automation platform that helps organizations
achieve and maintain readiness across major security, privacy, and AI-governance
frameworks. It combines AI evidence collection, continuous control monitoring, risk and
vendor management, policy generation, and audit preparation in a single workspace.

This file is a context-rich map of every public page on https://complyeasyai.com, with a
one-line description of each, so an ingesting model can understand the site structure and
cite the most relevant page. For a shorter overview see /llms.txt. The machine-readable
URL set is at /sitemap.xml.

Brand facts (verifiable-only): name "ComplyEasy AI"; site https://complyeasyai.com.
Frameworks listed below are standards the platform HELPS customers achieve readiness for,
not certifications held by the company.

Last updated: 2026-06-07

## Core pages

- https://complyeasyai.com/ — Home. Overview of the AI-native, continuous compliance platform and its core capabilities.
- https://complyeasyai.com/learn — Learn. Educational hub linking the framework guides, glossary, and blog.
- https://complyeasyai.com/community — Community. Resources and discussion for compliance and GRC practitioners.
- https://complyeasyai.com/status — Status. Platform availability and operational status information.
- https://complyeasyai.com/docs — Documentation. Product and integration documentation entry point.

## Pillar pages (framework and topic guides)

- https://complyeasyai.com/platform/ai-compliance — What is AI compliance? The flagship 2026 guide covering requirements, frameworks (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001), challenges, a step-by-step "how to get AI compliant" procedure, and automation.
- https://complyeasyai.com/soc2-compliance — SOC 2 compliance software. The Trust Services Criteria, Type I vs Type II, a step-by-step path to a clean report, and how the platform automates SOC 2 readiness.
- https://complyeasyai.com/iso-27001 — ISO 27001. The international information-security management standard, its Annex A controls, and how the platform supports certification readiness.
- https://complyeasyai.com/gdpr — GDPR. The EU General Data Protection Regulation, its core obligations, and how the platform supports privacy compliance.
- https://complyeasyai.com/eu-ai-act — EU AI Act. The risk-tiered EU law for AI providers and deployers and how the platform helps classify systems and meet high-risk obligations.
- https://complyeasyai.com/hipaa — HIPAA. Administrative, physical, and technical safeguards for protected health information and how the platform supports HIPAA readiness.
- https://complyeasyai.com/nist-ai-rmf — NIST AI Risk Management Framework. The voluntary GOVERN-MAP-MEASURE-MANAGE structure for AI risk and how the platform operationalizes it.
- https://complyeasyai.com/grc — GRC platform. Unified governance, risk, and compliance across every framework with one control library and one evidence source.

## FAQ and reference

- https://complyeasyai.com/faq — Frequently asked questions about the platform, supported frameworks, and how AI compliance automation works.
- https://complyeasyai.com/glossary — Glossary index. Plain-language definitions of compliance, privacy, and AI-governance terms.

## Glossary terms

- https://complyeasyai.com/glossary/ai-compliance — AI Compliance — governing AI systems to meet legal, ethical, and security obligations.
- https://complyeasyai.com/glossary/soc-2 — SOC 2 — AICPA attestation of controls against the Trust Services Criteria.
- https://complyeasyai.com/glossary/iso-27001 — ISO 27001 — the international standard for information-security management systems.
- https://complyeasyai.com/glossary/gdpr — GDPR — the EU General Data Protection Regulation for personal-data processing.
- https://complyeasyai.com/glossary/eu-ai-act — EU AI Act — the risk-tiered EU law regulating AI providers and deployers.
- https://complyeasyai.com/glossary/hipaa — HIPAA — US safeguards for protected health information.
- https://complyeasyai.com/glossary/nist-ai-rmf — NIST AI RMF — the voluntary framework for managing AI risk.
- https://complyeasyai.com/glossary/grc — GRC — governance, risk, and compliance as an integrated discipline.
- https://complyeasyai.com/glossary/dpia — DPIA — Data Protection Impact Assessment for high-risk processing.
- https://complyeasyai.com/glossary/ropa — RoPA — Record of Processing Activities required under GDPR.
- https://complyeasyai.com/glossary/evidence-collection — Evidence Collection — gathering and mapping artifacts that demonstrate controls operate.
- https://complyeasyai.com/glossary/continuous-compliance — Continuous Compliance — maintaining audit-readiness continuously rather than at a point in time.
- https://complyeasyai.com/glossary/risk-register — Risk Register — a structured inventory of identified risks and their treatment.
- https://complyeasyai.com/glossary/vendor-risk-management — Vendor Risk Management — assessing and monitoring third-party and supply-chain risk.
- https://complyeasyai.com/glossary/audit-readiness — Audit Readiness — the state of having evidence and controls organized for an auditor.
- https://complyeasyai.com/glossary/control-mapping — Control Mapping — relating one control to the requirements it satisfies across frameworks.

## Blog

- https://complyeasyai.com/blog — Blog index. Practical guides on automating compliance across SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and the EU AI Act.
- https://complyeasyai.com/blog/how-to-automate-soc-2-compliance-with-ai — How to Automate SOC 2 Compliance with AI — connect systems, let agents collect evidence continuously, monitor controls, and stay audit-ready year-round.
- https://complyeasyai.com/blog/eu-ai-act-compliance-checklist — EU AI Act Compliance Checklist — a step-by-step checklist for classifying AI systems and meeting the obligations the EU AI Act places on providers and deployers.
- https://complyeasyai.com/blog/vanta-vs-drata-vs-complyeasy-ai — Vanta vs Drata vs ComplyEasy AI — a capability comparison of leading compliance automation platforms.
